name: Reachy Mini
summary: Reachy Mini is a small open-source desktop robot from Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics, made for AI experiments, coding and human-robot interaction. It is 28 cm tall with a moving head, rotating body and two antennas, and it does not walk or grasp. It is sold as a Lite kit that plugs into a computer and a Wireless kit with onboard Raspberry Pi.
sensors: Wide-angle camera, 4 microphones, 5 W speaker, accelerometer (Wireless only).
compute: Lite: uses a connected Mac or Linux computer. Wireless: Raspberry Pi onboard.

price.configuration: Reachy Mini Lite, plus taxes and shipping (Wireless $499)

highlights: Head moves with 6 degrees of freedom, and the body rotates fully.
Launched at $299 (Lite) and $449 (Wireless); the Hugging Face page now lists $399 and $499.
caveats: A desktop robot, not a full humanoid: no legs, arms or hands.
Shipping time was stated as about 90 days.

sources.title: Reachy Mini - The Open-Source Robot for Today's and Tomorrow's AI Builders
